lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in an increasingly sparse spatial distribution from the anterior to posterior flank. Anterior clusters exhibit smaller diameters and higher density, while posterior clusters exhibit larger diameters and greater inter-centroid distances.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontally aligned high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature in the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from high-luminance (dorsal) to low-luminance (ventral) pixel values.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, low-luminance biological form (remora) attached to the lower lateral flank, creating a localized occlusion of the primary pattern.
